imageQa.note: Intentional image-free editorial layouts. The cutting-board guide uses exact-category Amazon text links only; no editorial, affiliate or product image is added or changed.

searchConsole.signal: BeautifulMensClub.com recorded 412 impressions, zero clicks, 0% CTR and average position 28.24. The submitted-sitemap snapshot still reported 212 URLs while the pre-publication repository sitemap contained 269 canonical URLs, a material discovery gap with no reported sitemap warning or error.
searchConsole.decision: No page is labeled Data-led because no query or page cluster had repeatable, decision-grade volume. The discovery gap instead shaped the work: three unrelated evergreen pages are exposed from the homepage, Library and three department hubs, reinforced by twelve reciprocal contextual links and added to a regenerated 272-URL sitemap.
searchConsole.ignored: One impression for ‘beard system’ at position 4, three combined impressions for two CDC jet-lag queries at positions 7–8, one public-Wi-Fi impression at position 19 and four capsule-wardrobe impressions at position 9 were deliberately ignored as too small, already served or unrelated.

monetization.placement: Three disclosed sponsored/nofollow exact-category text links appear only on the cutting-board guide: nonporous boards, hardwood boards and stable large-format boards. Readers are told to verify the exact material, dimensions, care instructions, seller and return terms. The stain-removal and gym-bag guides remain commerce-free.

authority.action: Created a citation-ready cutting-board decision matrix that separates food job, material disclosure, usable area, stability, cleaning route, cross-contamination control, wear inspection and replacement, with direct USDA and FDA source routes.
authority.cluster: Life now connects the cutting-board matrix to chef’s knives, food thermometers, allergen handoffs and the kitchen closing system. Style connects stain triage to care labels, detergent dosing, garment repair and steam care. Fitness connects gym-bag hygiene to hydration, equipment inspection, running-shoe care and laundry control.
authority.opportunity: No outreach opportunity was logged: the highest-value authority action was the on-site cutting-board specification asset, its primary-source digest and reciprocal topic-cluster reinforcement. No outreach was sent.

diversity: The batch answers three different questions across Life, Style and Fitness: which cutting-board system fits a kitchen and can be maintained safely; how to triage a garment stain without damaging the fabric; and how to pack, empty and clean a gym bag so used gear does not contaminate the next session. The cutting-board guide serves high purchase intent, the stain field guide expands wardrobe-care authority, and the gym-bag system explores an underserved operational problem. Analytics shaped discovery architecture rather than topics because its query samples were too weak.
